subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should this PR publish `buildOpenClawRegistryExport` as a stable root `clawhub-schema` API now, and should the bridge be scoped to hosted catalog feeds, account/publisher feeds, or both?
rationale: The remaining blocker is public API and OpenClaw/ClawHub contract direction, which automation cannot safely decide from code correctness alone.

options.title: Confirm the bridge contract before merge
options.body: Have a maintainer approve the exported helper shape and its intended feed scope before this becomes a stable downstream schema API.

options.title: Keep the helper internal until the contract settles
options.body: Scope or rename the helper so consumers do not treat it as a stable root `clawhub-schema` API yet.

options.title: Pause behind the account-feed PR
options.body: Wait for the account/publisher feed API PR to settle, then decide whether this bridge should remain separate or be revised around that contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm the bridge contract before merge
recommendation.body: Have a maintainer approve the exported helper shape and its intended feed scope before this becomes a stable downstream schema API.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest recent history on the catalog feed schema and public package contract this bridge extends.
